name: Kenjou Maya
source:
She has a naturally arrogant personality because everything has gone her way up until now.

She has been attending Miyanomori, which has an elevator system, since the kindergarten division and hopes to go on to higher education, but if she hadn't been badly behaved, it would have been easy to go on, but due to her arrogant attitude and inability to read the atmosphere, she has been deemed to have bad behavior and her chances of going on to higher education are in jeopardy.

In order to improve her school report, she became the manager of the rugby club, which has the most power in the club, from her third year, but she basically leaves the managerial duties to Hinako Hino, a first-year student.
